setup_multiprocessing_env: setup multi-processing environment variables including fork start method, opencv threads, OMP and MKL thread counts
register_mmpose_modules: register all mmpose modules including codecs, datasets, engine, evaluation, models, and visualization into registries
configure_opencv_threads: configure opencv multithreading by setting the number of threads to avoid system overload during training
setup_omp_mkl_threads: setup OMP and MKL environment variables to limit thread count per process and prevent system overload
init_default_scope: initialize the mmpose default scope in mmengine DefaultScope for registry-based module building
